name: Yet Another Entity Iterator
description: A developer service that loads and iterates entities in memory-efficient chunks.
project_description: Yet Another Entity Iterator is a small developer utility that exposes a single autowireable factory service (another_entity_iterator.factory) for loading and iterating large sets of entities in memory-efficient chunks. Instead of calling loadMultiple() on thousands of IDs at once, callers pass an entity type class and an iterable of IDs and receive a lazy ChunkedIterator that loads a fixed number of entities at a time and clears the entity memory cache between chunks. It provides no routes, permissions, controllers, forms, config schema, or Drush commands — it is purely an API for custom code, controllers, and services.
